name: Eridu
summary: A later Eridu comparison with an Ur III monument and a more formal irrigation-form study.
scaleNote: The close view reaches 120 metres across. Object size and rendered detail do not establish survey accuracy. Settlement extent is unresolved and the rendered envelope is illustrative.

features.label: What belongs at this date
features.text: The earliest frame uses a modest rebuilt-shrine interpretation. Earlier Ubaid temple levels are not asserted as still standing in 3200 BCE. The later frame adds the separately dated Ur III tradition.

features.label: Water and wetlands
features.basis: Broad setting supported; precise routes unresolved
features.text: Levees, channels, backwaters and marsh margins form the visual base. The same schematic river corridor is retained in both comparison frames because a dated migration line has not been established here. No inferred movement is presented as a measured river-course change.

features.label: Irrigation chronology
features.basis: Later dated evidence; model geometry illustrative
features.text: Eridu-region samples distinguish very early irrigation from later organized canal systems. The later field pattern illustrates that technological evidence; neither frame copies the cumulative surviving canal network. Canal-fill dates do not prove a particular network operated in 2050 BCE. Continuity of any individual channel is not assumed.

features.label: Reeds, riparian growth and palms
features.text: Reed fringes and woody stream margins are shown separately from cultivated palm gardens and fields. Tree placement, density and ground color are rendering choices; no pollen-to-canopy percentage or uniform deforestation trend is claimed.

features.label: Detail and uncertainty
features.text: Finer visual sampling does not create new archaeological evidence. The analytic surface is not an ancient elevation model. Missing dated geometry remains an explicit research gap, even when the scene is visually detailed.

features.label: Streets, courtyards and animal life
features.basis: Preserved model detail reconciled with the dated foundation
features.text: Earlier neighborhood and representative animal detail has been restored around the retained phase-specific monuments. Paths avoid modeled buildings and water; their alignments, household positions, herd sizes and movement are interpretation. Shared neighborhood templates between comparison dates do not assert that individual houses or roads survived unchanged.

footprintEvidence: approximate scale envelope; not a traced excavation plan
roadEvidence: Feature types and broad connections may be documented; all rendered centerlines are interpretive, not surveyed ancient itineraries.
ecologyEvidence: Regional and selected site evidence informs the palette. Canopy cover, exact species placements, field boundaries, season and animal counts are illustrative.
terrainEvidence: Original analytic terrain shaped to broad documented landform character. Not a DEM, historical elevation survey, or recovered ancient shoreline.
